name: speech_edit
description: Apply an edited speech text to the project in one write: cut words or lines, shorten pauses, move or repeat lines, bring back unused lines. Captions, overlays and synced layers follow the speech. Saves a version first. preview shows the result without changing anything.

input.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

output.description: {applied, preview, noop, version, before, after, cut, moved, pauses, clamped, hardCuts, carried, flagged, text}

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: text
params.description: Absolute path of the edited speech text (speech-text.md from speech_text).

params.name: preview
params.description: Show the result and change nothing.

params.name: max-pause
params.description: Cap every pause the text did not change, in seconds. Default 0.45 with feel natural, none with tight.

params.name: feel
params.description: natural keeps more silence at each cut (0.18 s at least where the gaps hold it, a wider pad at a hard cut where there is silence for it). tight is the sharper cut: use it only when the user asks for a tighter cut.
